findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_property, prepare_design_review, design_yard, get_account, get_profile, get_design_review, get_continuation_link, get_quote_options, get_quote_request, get_lead, respond_to_lead, subscribe · Private data: find_property, prepare_design_review, get_profile, get_design_review, get_continuation_link, get_quote_options, get_quote_request, list_my_leads, get_lead, respond_to_lead · Public sink: find_property, design_yard, get_account, get_profile, get_continuation_link, get_quote_options, get_quote_request, get_lead, preview_lead_response, respond_to_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_property, prepare_design_review, design_yard, get_account, get_profile, get_design_review, get_continuation_link, get_quote_options, get_quote_request, get_lead, respond_to_lead, subscribe · Private data: find_property, prepare_design_review, get_profile, get_design_review, get_continuation_link, get_quote_options, get_quote_request, list_my_leads, get_lead, respond_to_lead · Public sink: find_property, design_yard, get_account, get_profile, get_continuation_link, get_quote_options, get_quote_request, get_lead, preview_lead_response, respond_to_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
